known_constraints: Current H3 node accepts text and image references, not source-video motion or source-audio reference.
H3 template currently generates 124 frames at 24 fps (5.167 seconds); original cuts require different durations.
Final wide shot has persistent text in the source, requiring a clean nodal-generated reference or Ref2VA reconstruction.
A successful generation is not proof of accurate Korean speech or exact reconstruction.
